items.docs: Sends a single typed capability command to a device - for example on_off/powerSwitch to turn power on or off, range/brightness to set brightness, color_setting/colorRgb or colorTemperatureK to set color, dynamic_scene or diy_scene to apply a scene, or segment_color_setting/segmentedColorRgb and segmentedBrightness to address individual RGBIC segments.
